detailZones.title: Check-in counter row shell
detailZones.description: Follow the metal counter fronts, ledges and brown partitions along the staffed row.

detailZones.title: Staffed desk equipment
detailZones.description: Identify the staffed workstation, the rear of the desk monitor, its stand and the separate equipment shelf.

detailZones.title: Baggage scale and conveyor
detailZones.description: Trace the black belts between the desks and the row of exposed silver rollers on the right.

detailZones.title: Self-service kiosk bank
detailZones.description: Follow the row of freestanding kiosks from the nearest cabinet to the far screen and its metal base.

detailZones.title: Overhead display wall
detailZones.description: Find the dark overhead displays, their metal supports, and the wall and window framing behind them.

detailZones.title: Queue and accessible lane
detailZones.description: Trace the queue from the metal posts and belt clips to the open passenger lane beside the windows.

detailZones.title: Floor and baggage ancillaries
detailZones.description: Look at the foreground stone tiles, the open waste bin and the lower edges of the counter and kiosks.

anchorAudit.rationale: The counter row, desk equipment, conveyors, kiosks, displays, queue and floor were matched to features visible in the 1600 by 900 photograph. The nearest kiosk is identifiable by its cabinet. The function of its dark recess is indistinct, so card readers, printers and other unresolved equipment stay in the scene index.
